name: @poolstatis/mcp
description: Official stdio MCP server for Poolstatis agent-native product analytics

scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../.. build && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/core/mcp && cp ../../dist/mcp/server.js ../../dist/mcp/server.d.ts ../../dist/mcp/standard.js ../../dist/mcp/browserStandard.js ../../dist/mcp/browserStandard.d.ts ../../dist/mcp/actorsStandard.js ../../dist/mcp/actorsStandard.d.ts dist/core/mcp/ && cp ../../dist/schemas.js dist/core/ && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE && chmod 755 dist/cli.js
